title: Run SAM 3D Body locally (open-source) or on Comfy Cloud to extract body motion…
content: Run SAM 3D Body locally (open-source) or on Comfy Cloud to extract body motion from a recording, then import that motion into Blender to control the camera, and use the resulting motion/camera setup as input for Seedance 2.5 for tighter control over body motion and camera movement.
tips: Run SAM 3D Body locally (open-source) or on Comfy Cloud to extract body motion from a recording, then import that motion into Blender to control the camera, and use the resulting motion/camera setup as input for Seedance 2.5 for tighter control over body motion and camera movement.

es.content:
Ejecuta SAM 3D Body localmente (open-source) o en Comfy Cloud para extraer el movimiento corporal de una grabación; luego importa ese movimiento en Blender para controlar la cámara y usa el movimiento/configuración de cámara resultante como entrada para Seedance 2.5, para un control más preciso sobre el movimiento corporal y el movimiento de cámara.

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Hilo 1] SAM3D Body https://t.co/iyeyAfF6H8

[Hilo 2] Seedance 2.5 https://t.co/tTyOlKzugz
